findings.message: Schema drops its owning TWorld, so CommandDispatcher<WorldB> can accept WorldA invokers and route authorization/events into the wrong world. Retain an internal world discriminator, reject generic consumer mismatches at construction, and add a two-world no-activity regression without changing the wire hash.

validation: Exact range, merge base, ownership, clean worktree and diff checks verified.
All other frozen schema, staging, command result, constraint, XML and README clauses passed review.
Worker build and ten focused tests accepted; Unity EditMode remains deferred.
